body.name: Published-normal gap sieve and finite-support plug-in
body.construction:
For a declared comparator rule \(z\in\{\mathrm{OVS},\mathrm{const}\}\), let \(b_z(P)\) denote the law-dependent loading obtained from \(\Omega(P)\) by the corresponding Moore--Penrose KKT rule; it is not held fixed as the law varies.  Its loss relative to the published OVS bound is
\[
\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp},z}(P)
=\operatorname{Var}_P\{b_z(P)'\Psi_P(O)\}-V_{\mathrm{OVS}}(P).
\tag{G1}
\]
For the population general-covariate sieve, project the bounded dictionary against the published normal.  Thus
\[
a_{j,P}(x)=K_{\mathrm{OVS},P}(x)^\dagger
E_P[Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}}\{v_j-E_Pv_j\}\mid X=x],
\qquad
t_{j,P}=v_j-E_Pv_j-a_{j,P}(X)'Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}},
\tag{G2}
\]
followed by \(G_{J_n,P}=E_P[t_{J_n,P}t_{J_n,P}']\) and
\[
g_{\Delta,J_n,P,j}=D\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp},z,P}[t_{j,P}],
\qquad
\zeta_{\Delta,J_n,P}=t_{J_n,P}'G_{J_n,P}^\dagger g_{\Delta,J_n,P}.
\tag{G3}
\]
The derivative in (G3) differentiates the observed-law quantities \(p,m,\pi,\theta,\Psi,\Omega,Z^{\mathrm{OVS}},K_{\mathrm{OVS}},r_{\mathrm{OVS}}\), the comparator rule \(b_z(P)\), and every locally selected-rank inverse.

For pointwise inference, suppose \(X\) has fixed support \(\{x_1,\ldots,x_D\}\).  Define the observable finite vector \(U(O)\) by stacking, separately, all coordinates
\[
U_d^X=\mathbf 1\{X=x_d\},
\qquad
U^{(0)}_{d,a,s}=\mathbf 1\{X=x_d,G=a,S=s\},
\tag{G4}
\]
\[
U^{(1,u)}_{d,a,s}=U^{(0)}_{d,a,s}\Delta Y_u,
\qquad
U^{(2,u,v)}_{d,a,s}=U^{(0)}_{d,a,s}\Delta Y_u\Delta Y_v,
\tag{G5}
\]
for every support point, retained cohort--eligibility cell, and \(u,v\in\{2,\ldots,T\}\).  Let \(d_\mu\) be the number of stacked coordinates and \(\mu(P)=E_P[U(O)]\).  The separate coordinates \(U_d^X\) reconstruct every support mass exactly.  The remaining coordinates reconstruct all conditional cell probabilities, first moments, and second cross-moments, hence reconstruct \(p,m,\pi,\theta,\Psi,\Omega,Z^{\mathrm{OVS}},K_{\mathrm{OVS}},r_{\mathrm{OVS}}\).

Let \(b^{\mathrm{ref}}\) put weight \(\omega_k\) on \((k,c_0(k))\) and zero on the other score coordinates.  For every moment vector in the overlap domain define
\[
F_z(\mu)=b_z(\mu)'\Omega(\mu)b_z(\mu)
-\left\{b^{\mathrm{ref}\prime}\Omega(\mu)b^{\mathrm{ref}}
-\sum_{d=1}^D P_\mu(X=x_d)
r_{\mathrm{OVS},\mu}(x_d)'K_{\mathrm{OVS},\mu}(x_d)^\dagger
r_{\mathrm{OVS},\mu}(x_d)\right\}.
\tag{G6}
\]
Every inverse in (G6), including an indefinite comparator KKT inverse, is operationally replaced by the spectral inverse that retains exactly eigenvalues satisfying \(|\lambda|>\tau_n\).  Denote the resulting map by \(F_{z,\tau_n}\).  With \(\widehat\mu=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nU(O_i)\), define
\[
\widehat\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}=F_{z,\tau_n}(\widehat\mu).
\tag{G7}
\]
Let \(\widehat d_z\) be the analytic derivative of the selected-rank branch of \(F_z\) at \(\widehat\mu\), put
\[
\widehat\xi_{z,i}=\widehat d_z'\{U(O_i)-\widehat\mu\},
\qquad
\widehat V_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat\xi_{z,i}^2,
\tag{G8}
\]
and set
\[
T_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}
=\frac{\sqrt n\{\widehat\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp},z}(P)\}}
{\sqrt{\widehat V_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}}}.
\tag{G9}
\]
The population OVS-tangent Riesz representer \(\zeta_{\Delta,b_z}\) is defined separately by
\(E_P[\zeta_{\Delta,b_z}s]=D\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp},z,P}[s]\) for every \(s\in\mathcal T_{P,\mathrm{OVS}}\); the plug-in influence function in the finite-support theorem is the explicitly displayed moment derivative and need not be the efficient influence function for the gap.
